note: Round 146: aspecting the nanites to an element. Active meditation (walk while you draw breath) is how it grows and how its buff is kept up; sitting refines it. Elements follow the five-element wheel the game already uses.

wood.name: Verdant Thread
wood.text: Growth and mending: you recover life as you go, and kills heal you.

fire.name: Ember Thread
fire.text: The strike: blows land harder and more often true.

earth.name: Stone Thread
earth.text: Endurance: you take less damage and hold more life.

metal.name: Edge Thread
metal.text: Precision: quicker hands and a stronger guard.

water.name: Tide Thread
water.text: Flow: qi comes easier, sitting runs deeper, and you slip more blows.

secrets.name: Roots Beneath
secrets.text: The thread learns to drink from the ground. A little life comes back even when the aspect is quiet.

secrets.name: Sudden Bloom
secrets.text: Kills feed it. Something green answers the swarm.

secrets.name: The First Spark
secrets.text: You learn where a blow wants to land. A little more edge, always.

secrets.name: Furnace Heart
secrets.text: The swarm runs hot and steady. Your blows carry a little more.

secrets.name: Footing
secrets.text: You stop being pushed around by the ground. You take a touch less damage, always.

secrets.name: Deep Marrow
secrets.text: The thread reaches the bone. Your body holds a little more.

secrets.name: Keen Line
secrets.text: You find the straight way between two points. A little quicker, always.

secrets.name: Ringing Guard
secrets.text: Your guard rings true. A touch more ward, always.

secrets.name: Still Water
secrets.text: Sitting runs a little deeper, always.

secrets.name: Tide Table
secrets.text: You feel the pull of qi like a tide. A little more qi, always.

secrets.name: The Five Threads
secrets.text: Every thread is woven. The swarm hums in five keys at once, and sometimes they agree.
